newsitem.title: JAPAN: Osaka undecided on moves against Nomura -- officials.
newsitem.headline: Osaka undecided on moves against Nomura -- officials.

text.p: The prefectural and city governments of Osaka have not made any decisions on whether to suspend Nomura Securities Co Ltd from participating in bond underwriting, officials of the governments said.
"Nomura is a member of the underwriting syndicate for Osaka prefectural government bonds. However, we have not made a decision what we will do," said an official of the Osaka prefectural government.
"We would like to decide soon, possibly within this week." An official of the Osaka city government said his government had yet to consider whether to take any action against Nomura.

The Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission (SESC) filed complaints with prosecutors on Tuesday alleging that Nomura and three former Nomura executives illegally compensated a corporate client for losses.

Japan's Ministry of Finance said on Tuesday evening it was suspending Nomura from Japanese government bond (JGB) auctions and bond underwriting until administrative penalties against the brokerage to be proposed by the SESC are implemented.
